'''Lura Tranor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], Lura Tranor was [[Jedi training/Legends|educated]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], attaining the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] by the time of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]. Selecting the young [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiate]] [[Jyl Somtay]] as her [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], the Master-Padawan duo trained together for several years until Somtay achieved the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]].<ref name="DITC" />

At the height of the Separatist Crisis, the tensions between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] came to a head on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] with the arrest and trial of Jedi [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. When [[Master of the Order/Legends|Master of the Order]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] formed a [[Jedi assault team/Legends|strike team]] to rescue the Jedi and senator, Jedi Somtay was away but Master Tranor answered the call. Following her fellow Jedi to the dusty world, Master Tranor helped storm the [[Petranaki arena]] and took up her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] against the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]]. Despite her bravery and skill, Master Tranor lost her life during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|bloody battle]].<ref name="DITC" />
